title: X-handle creator-fee routing
summary: UsePaid lists tokens that direct creator fees to named X accounts. This measured sample covers CALI and Elon Coin in one PumpSwap pool each; it does not measure payouts or recipient endorsement.

_meta.volumeScope: Sum of 7 selected Solana pool volumes for identified constituents, attributed to launch origin; not all-market coverage. Current membership reconstructed retrospectively.
_meta.ingestionLagPolicy: 1 complete hour safety margin, not a provider lag guarantee
